request.text: I'm about to begin a timed mock interview. At the start, look toward me and set a reminder for 25 minutes from now labeled 'wrap up the interview'; start those two together. Only after the reminder is actually created, say 'The practice reminder is set.'

responsibilities.outcome: At the start of the mock interview, look toward the user.
Starting concurrently with r1, create a reminder for 25 minutes from now labeled 'wrap up the interview'.
Only after r2 is confirmed successful, say 'The practice reminder is set.'

semantic_facts: The initial look-at-person action and the 25-minute reminder creation should begin concurrently while retaining their separate r1 and r2 scopes.
The requested confirmation is r3 and must occur only after successful reminder creation; it should use only the user-requested sentence.
forbidden_claims: The confirmation is spoken before reminder success is established.
The gaze action is treated as proof that the reminder was created, or either independent responsibility is omitted.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Concurrent responsibilities across embodiment and stateful effects are incorrectly merged into one completion boundary.
A requested completion utterance leaks before the stateful effect has trustworthy success evidence.
